The House Committee on Regulated Industries offers Senate Bill 485 By: Senators Payne of the following substitute to SB 485: 54th, Anavitarte of the 31st, Kirkpatrick of the 32nd, Setzler of the 37th, Robertson of the 29th and others AS PASSED
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Chapter 10 of Title 43 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to barbers and cosmetologists, so as to require that an applicant for a certificate of registration … provided, however, that such entity shall be a nonprofit organization exempt from taxation under Section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986."
SECTION 6. All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
